text:
ajay: booking maintenance slot ms-907 for tenant-slice safelock + staged backfill. start 2026-02-18T03:00:00Z, window 60m. plan: apply DDL on slice, then 3x small backfill waves. pin runtime to v2.15.0-hotfix during window.

deploybot: slot ms-907 registered. start=2026-02-18T03:00:00Z window=60m owner=@ajay holdpoints=[preflight-check, canary-pass] autopause=10m

nina: canary plan: two tiny tenants on region-eu, backfill rate=500r/s, workers=6, db-max-conns=100. will monitor replication_delay, p50/p99 qlatency.

terry: add guard: if pg_locks > 10s on >5 nodes -> immediate abort. also abort if deadlocks > 2 in 5m.

ajay: rollback shorthand in ops doc:
```
- stop waves: `scripts/migrate_ctl stop --slot ms-907`
- enable write-block: `ffctl set tenant_slice_write_block on`
- unpin api: `infractl pin api v2.14.8`
- roll back DDL if needed: `psql -f rollback/ms-907-revert.sql`
- notify: /msg #oncall "ms-907 abort initiated"
```

oncall-bot: reminder: release-notes draft due T-2h. add table-level impact and expected RTO.

nina: preflight checklist posted: smoke query, schema-compat test, sample pg_locks snapshot. I'll run smoke at T-30m.

deploybot: holdpoint created: ms-907.preflight-check. awaiting ACKs from @nina @terry. React with :white_check_mark: to continue.

terry: acked. :white_check_mark: running lock snapshot now.

nina: smoke OK. sample queries return in <15ms. canary ready.

deploybot: canary wave started (wave=1/4) target tenants=[t-1001,t-1002] workers=4 rate=500

ajay: watching replication. set alert if replication_delay > 45s for 3m.

nina: canary results: errors 0.07%, latency +2ms. pg_locks peeked at 1.2s. green to continue.

terry: starting full waves sequentially, spacing 8m between waves. I'll keep soft-eviction threshold at 25s for long queries.

ajay: note for rollback: if unpin fails due to scheduler lock, promote read-fallback and scale read replicas x2 for 10m.

deploybot: wave=2/4 started. queued=8 workers=6

oncall-bot: alert policy: page on error_rate > 0.5% sustained 5m or any deadlock seen.

nina: observed transient lock on shard-slice-3 lasting 6s, below threshold. continuing.

terry: wave=3/4 starting; lowering batch size to 200 for this wave due to CPU.

ajay: if we hit replication_delay > 70s we abort immediately and execute rollback steps.

deploybot: wave=3/4 complete. metrics: errors=0.22% (in threshold), replication_peak=52s. awaiting continue vote.

nina: +1 to continue but holdpoint remains. will start final wave after 5m observation.

oncall-bot: posting brief release note to #release-notes: "ms-907 tenant-slice safelock: staged DDL + backfill; runtime pinned to v2.15.0-hotfix during window; rollback plan in ops runbook."

terry: initiating last wave. monitoring pg_stat_activity and `psql -c \"SELECT * FROM pg_locks WHERE granted=false\"` snapshots every 30s.

ajay: final: capture post-run artifacts: lock snapshots, backfill logs, deploybot audit id. will open postmortem if any abort occurred. thanks team. :rocket:
